turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why did you ask for this meeting, and why before anyone called me about a zero?
Don't thank me yet. What is this about, Hale?
You obviously put the hours in with him. His reading level is years ahead of the class.
Flattery isn't evidence. Did you call me before the zero went in?
You're the kind of parent I wish every kid had.
Save it. What do you actually have on his essay?
So I'd love your blessing to handle this my way. I trust your judgment, and I hope you'll trust mine.
Handle it "my way" means what, exactly? I don't give blessings on a zero I haven't seen a reason for.
